Greetings, guest {naam}! I am Aeneas. Enemies in the forest are a nuisance. Defeat three enemies in the forest and you will have my help.
Excellent! You have defeated three enemies.
Good! Now defend the camp. Win the first battle.
You have defended the camp! Thank you.
Why should I go with you, leader {naam}?
Because I protect my friends and defend the camp.
Because I don't want to fight.
I will go with you, leader {naam}!
Troy has fallen. I am looking for a new homeland.
My father is old. I carry him on my shoulders.
The gods help me. I sail to Italy.
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Romulus. I am founding a new city. Defeat four enemies in the field and you will help me.
Excellent! You have defeated four enemies.
Good! Now defend the Latin Road. Win the second battle.
You have defended the road! Thank you.
Rome will become a great city. What do you do for the city?
I build walls and lead soldiers.
A she-wolf fed me. I have a brother, Remus.
I am founding the city on the Palatine.
Where does Romulus found the city?
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Horatius. Enemies are coming to the Tiber. Defeat three enemies at the Tiber.
Excellent! You have saved the bridge.
Good! Now defend the road. Win the second battle.
I defend the bridge. Will you defend the bridge too?
The Sublician Bridge spans the Tiber. Enemies are coming.
I defend the bridge alone. My friends are tearing the bridge down.
I jump into the Tiber. I swim to the bank.
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Cloelia. I was a hostage, but I escaped from the camp. Defeat three enemies at the Tiber.
Excellent! You have defended the Tiber.
Good! Now attack Ardea. Win the third battle.
You have defeated Ardea! Thank you.
I cross the Tiber on horseback. Are you brave too?
Yes, I am afraid of nothing.
No, I am afraid of everything.
I was a hostage among the enemy. I escape at night.
I take a horse and cross the Tiber.
The Romans praise me. My statue stands on the road.
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Mucius. There are enemies on the road. Defeat three enemies on the road.
Excellent! You have cleared the road.
I hold my right hand in the fire. Am I afraid of pain, perhaps?
No, because I love my homeland.
Yes, I am afraid of pain.
I am going to the enemy king. I want to kill him.
I put my right hand into the fire.
What does Mucius put into the fire?
The king lets me go. My name is Scaevola.
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Camilla. I live in the forest. Defeat four enemies in the forest.
Excellent! You have saved the forest.
I run fast and shoot arrows. What do you do?
I run fast and fight the enemies.
I sleep in a little house.
I love the forests. I run with the horses.
I shoot arrows and defeat the enemies.
My father raised me in the forest.
Where did Camilla's father raise her?
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Hercules. There are lions on the mountain. Defeat four enemies on the mountain.
Excellent! You have cleared the mountain.
Good! Now we do the first labour. Win the battle.
You have completed the labour! Thank you.
I do many tasks. Do you work hard too?
I defeat the Nemean lion. His skin covers me.
How many tasks does Hercules carry out?
I defeat the Hydra in the swamp.
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Perseus. The Gorgons live by the coast. Defeat three enemies by the coast.
Excellent! You have saved the coast.
Good! Now we attack Medusa. Win the first battle.
You have won the battle! Thank you.
I can carry Medusa's head. Will you help me?
Yes, I'm happy to help you.
No, I am afraid of Medusa!
Medusa has snakes on her head.
What does Medusa have on her head?
I have winged sandals. I fly through the air.
I rescue Andromeda and defeat Medusa.
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Theseus. The Minotaur is in the labyrinth. Defeat four enemies in the city.
Excellent! You have saved the city.
Good! Now we enter the labyrinth. Win the second battle.
You have defeated the labyrinth! Thank you.
I am looking for the Minotaur in the labyrinth. Will you come with me?
Yes, I follow you and I rescue the brothers.
No, I am afraid of the labyrinth.
The Minotaur lives in the labyrinth.
I defeat the Minotaur and leave the labyrinth.
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Atalanta. I hunt in the olive groves. Defeat four enemies in the olive groves.
Defeat enemies in the olive groves!
Excellent! You have saved the olive groves.
Good! Now we look for the boar. Win the battle.
I am the fastest. Do you run fast?
I run fast, but I don't beat you.
I defeat the Calydonian boar with arrows.
In running I beat all the men.
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Jason. I am building the ship Argo. Defeat three enemies by the coast.
Excellent! You have freed the coast.
Good! Now we look for the Golden Fleece. Win the second battle.
I sail for the Golden Fleece. Do you have a ship?
I have a ship and brave sailors.
I have no ship, but I am afraid.
The Golden Fleece is in Colchis.
Medea helps me. She puts the dragon to sleep.
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Medea. I am looking for herbs. Defeat three enemies in the olive grove.
Defeat enemies in the olive grove!
Excellent! The olive grove is free.
Good! Now I help Jason. Win the second battle.
I gather herbs in the forest.
I put the dragon to sleep. Jason takes the fleece.
Who puts the dragon to sleep?
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Daedalus. I build machines. Defeat three enemies by the coast.
Good! Now I build the labyrinth. Win the first battle.
Because I am afraid of machines.
I build the labyrinth for Minos.
I make wings from feathers and wax.
What are the wings made of?
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Prometheus. I gave fire to humankind. Defeat three enemies by the coast.
Good! Now I resist Jupiter. Win the first battle.
Jupiter punishes me. Why should I go with you?
Because I am afraid of Jupiter.
An eagle eats my liver. Hercules frees me.
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Achilles. The Trojans are fighting in front of the walls. Defeat four enemies in the field.
Excellent! You have cleared the field.
Good! Now attack the walls of Troy. Win the battle.
You have conquered the walls! Thank you.
My anger is great. Why do you fight?
My mother is a goddess. Her name is Thetis.
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Hector. I defend Troy. Defeat four enemies in front of the walls.
Defeat enemies in front of the walls!
Excellent! You have saved the walls.
Good! Now defend the walls of Troy. Win the battle.
You have defended the walls! Thank you.
I fight for my homeland. Do you love your homeland too?
Yes, I love my homeland and my family.
My homeland means nothing to me.
Priam is my father. He is the king of Troy.
Who is the king of Troy?
In front of the walls I fight Achilles.
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Odysseus. The Greek ships lie on the coast. Defeat three enemies by the coast.
Excellent! You have saved the ships.
Good! Now we build the wooden horse. Win the second battle.
You have built the horse! Thank you.
I am cunning. I make plans. Who makes plans with you?
I am afraid of the horse.
I build the wooden horse. Soldiers hide inside the horse.
I want to return home. Penelope is waiting for me.
How many eyes does Polyphemus have?
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Penthesilea. I fight at the Scamander. Defeat three enemies at the Scamander.
Excellent! You have saved the Scamander.
Good! Now we help Troy. Win the second battle.
You have helped Troy! Thank you.
I am the queen of the Amazons. Do you fight for Troy?
No, I fight for the enemies.
I have a bow and arrows.
I fight Achilles, but I am defeated.
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Cassandra. I see danger. Defeat three enemies in front of the walls.
Good! Now I save Troy. Win the first battle.
Nobody believes me. Do you believe me?
I see the wooden horse. There is danger!
Apollo gave me a gift, but nobody believes me.
My father is a king. His name is Priam.
Greetings, leader {naam}! I am Circe. I love herbs and wolves. Defeat three enemies by the coast.
Good! Now I help Odysseus. Win the second battle.
I turn people into pigs. Why should I go with you?
I live on the island of Aeaea.
I turn Odysseus' companions into pigs.
Who does Circe turn into pigs?
I have herbs. Odysseus is not afraid of me.
